blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.
blocks.zh: 计算社会科学越来越依赖大语言模型来进行文字注释,现在公布的研究结果是否有效取决于这些模型所产生的标签. 决策模型,一个为断然回答问题而构建的新模型类,以选择方式回答打字的问题,在标签集上概率分布,信心分数而不是自由文本,以边框推断价格的一小部分. 他们的答案是否准确,以及所宣称的信心是否能够相信社会科学的构造,是未知的. 在这里,我们反映Ziems等人(2024年)对18项计算社会科学分类任务的评价(7,977项),将第一个商业决策模型和两个开放量级对应模型与19个前沿和开放量级语言模型进行同一零镜头协议下的比较. 决策模式在15项评价任务中的14项上跟踪了每个任务中最佳的LLM,中位赤字为11.6个宏观-F1点,中位值为计量成本的44倍。 它的置信度比19个LLMs中16个的口服置信度更准,然而有3个前沿模型显示中位校准误差较低(0.157对0.066). 虽然0.9以上项目通常被贴上准确的标签(中间准确度0.815),但有一项任务,即同行支持对话中的同情,模型报告,在进行近乎偶然的情况下,具有高度的信心。 然而,我们的结果表明,决策模式作为说明程序的第一步是有用的:将低信心项目与LLM匹配,或以成本的四分之一至一半超出LLM。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A growing share of empirical social science now rests on labels produced by large language models. Since Ziems et al. showed that zero-shot LLMs reach fair agreement with human annotators across a broad suite of computational social science (CSS) tasks [ 1 ] , researchers have used LLMs to code stance, ideology, hate speech, and discourse structure in datasets far larger than any human team could annotate [ 2 , 3 ] . The question is no longer whether a model can label social science text, but whether a researcher can know, for a given item, how much to trust the label [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 经验性社会科学的比重越来越大,现在取决于大型语言模型所产生的标签。 自齐姆斯等. 研究者用LLMs在数据集中编码立场、意识形态、仇恨言论和言论结构, 问题不再在于一个模型是否能够给社会科学文本贴上标签,而是研究者是否能够知道,对于某个特定项目,该标签有多少值得信赖[4].

blocks.en: Frontier LLMs answer that question poorly for three reasons. First, chat-tuned models produce free text, so the label must be extracted from a generated answer, and a failed extraction produces a wrong label rather than an error. Second, the APIs serving frontier models rarely expose token-level probabilities (none of the 19 baseline APIs in our evaluation returned usable ones; Section 3.3), so calibration must be elicited verbally, and verbalized confidence is known to be poorly calibrated [ 5 ] . Third, frontier inference is priced for conversation, and labeling a corpus of several million items at frontier prices costs five to six figures, beyond most research budgets.
blocks.zh: Frontier LLMS对此问题的回答欠佳有三个原因. 首先,聊天调试的模型会产生自由文本,所以标签必须从生成的答案中提取,失败的提取会产生错误的标签而不是错误. 第二,服务于前沿模型的API很少暴露象征性的概率(我们评价中的19个基线API中没有一个返回了可用的概率;第3.3节),因此校准必须用口头方式进行,而口语化的信心则已知校准差[5]. 第三,边际推论是用于对话的,以边际价格标出几百万件物品的代价是5至6个数字,超出了大多数研究预算。

blocks.en: A new class of models addresses all three limitations by construction. Decision models accept a typed question with an enumerated label set and return a choice, a probability distribution over the full label set, and a scalar confidence score; they do not generate free text. Reinforcement learning from calibrated decisions (RLCD) is one training approach for producing such models. The first commercially available decision model, TypeSafe’s Jev, was released in September 2026 with input pricing of $0.042 per million tokens, and an open-weight RLCD-trained counterpart, a 0.6B decision model built on Qwen3 and released two days later [ 6 ] , is available for local inference. The typed interface makes extraction errors impossible by construction, because the model can only return one of the declared options; the returned distribution makes calibration a directly measurable property of every labeling run rather than a separately elicited one; and the pricing changes what corpus sizes are feasible under constrained budgets. A decision model scores the declared options in a single forward pass rather than generating token by token, so small members of this class of model can run on hardware most research teams already own. Within days of Jev’s release, open-weight reproductions spanning 0.4B to 9B parameters appeared; we evaluate five of them alongside the commercial model to test whether our findings describe one vendor’s product or the class as a whole. RLCD here is distinct from reinforcement learning from contrastive distillation [ 7 ] , an unrelated alignment method that shares the acronym.
blocks.zh: 新的一类模型通过建筑解决了所有三种局限性。 决策模型接受一个带有所列举的标签集的打字问题,并返回一个选择,整个标签集的概率分布,以及一个scalar信任分数;它们不会生成自由文本. 加强从校准决定中学习(RLCD)是制作这种模型的一种培训方法。 第一个商业上可用的决定模型TypeSafe's Jev于2026年9月发布,投入定价为每百万令牌0.042美元,一个开放重量的RLCD训练对应器,一个基于Quen3的0.6B决定模型,两天后发布[6],可供本地推论. 键入的接口使提取错误无法通过构建实现,因为模型只能返回一个已宣布的选项;返回的分布使校准成为每个标签运行的直接可测量属性,而不是单独引出的一个属性;定价改变了在受限制的预算下哪些实体大小是可行的. 一个决定模型在一次前传中给所宣布的选项打分,而不是以象征性的方式产生令牌,所以这一类模型中的小成员可以运行在大多数研究团队已经拥有的硬件上. 在Jev发布后几天内,出现了0.4B到9B的开放式复制;我们评估其中5个参数与商业模型一起,以检验我们的调查结果是描述一个销售商的产品还是整个类别。 这里的RLCD不同于从对比性蒸馏法中吸取的强化学习[7],这种不相关的对齐方法共享缩写.

blocks.en: Whether these properties translate into accurate, trustworthy annotation on social science data is not obvious in either direction. CSS constructs are contested, socially situated, and often defined against codebooks that trained annotators disagree on. A confidence score calibrated on commercial decision workloads may not remain calibrated on implicit hate speech, on dialect features of Indian English, or on the discourse structure of Reddit arguments. If calibration holds, the annotation pipeline gains a component that labels at a small fraction of frontier prices and states, reliably, which items it should not label. If calibration fails, the confidence score would direct automation toward exactly the labels that most need human review.
blocks.zh: 这些属性是否转化为社会科学数据上准确,可信赖的注释,这两个方向都不明显. 计算机辅助系统的结构存在争议,处于社会位置,而且往往与受过培训的注释员意见不一的密码本相对应。 对商业决策工作量的置信分数的校准可能不会继续以隐含的仇恨言论、印度英语的方言特征或Reddit论点的论述结构为标准。 如果校准有效,注解管道将获得一个部件,其标签为前沿价格的一小部分,并可靠地说明哪些物品不应标签。 如果校准失败,信心分数将引导自动化到最需要人审查的标签上。

blocks.en: Here, we answer that question by mirroring the evaluation of Ziems et al. [1] on 18 of their CSS classification tasks, the same released test splits, and the same zero-shot protocol, comparing the decision-model class (Jev, plus an open-weight 0.6B RLCD decision model and its no-training ablation on the same base) against 19 LLM baselines spanning the GPT-5.6, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, and GLM families. Beyond the accuracy comparison, we add three measurements that the 2023-era evaluation could not include: calibration (expected calibration error and reliability diagrams, computed from the returned distributions), coverage–accuracy routing curves (the accuracy of the model on the subset of items it is confident about, as a function of the confidence threshold), and measured cost per million labels. The design, hypotheses, task grid, and correction procedure were pre-registered (AsPredicted #312,511), with three tasks used as a pilot and the remaining 15 evaluation tasks carrying all headline comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们通过反映对Ziems等人的评价来回答这个问题。 [1] 在其18个CSS分类任务中,同样的释放的测试分数,以及同样的零射线协议,比较了决定模型类(Jev,外加一个开放重量0.6B的RLCD决定模型及其在同一基座上的无训练减退)与跨越GPT-5.6,克劳德,双子座,Llama,Quen,DeepSek,Mistral,和GLM家族的19个LLM基线. 除了准确性比较之外,我们添加了2023年时期评价不能包括的三项测量:校准(预期校准误差和可靠性图,从返回的分布中计算),覆盖率-精确度路由曲线(作为置信阈值的函数,模型在它所信任的子集上的精确度),以及每百万个标签的测量成本。 设计、假设、任务网格和校正程序已预先登记(AsPresidented #312 511),其中三项任务用作试点,其余15项评价任务都包含所有标题比较。

blocks.en: We find, first, that the commercial decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of the 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, significant after false-discovery correction on 12 tasks; the confidence interval spans zero on ideological books, Indian English dialect, and character tropes. Second, its native calibration beats the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLM baselines but not that of the three frontier Claude models (median expected calibration error 0.157 against 0.066 for the best baseline). Third, items at or above 0.9 confidence reach a median accuracy of 0.815 at 0.376 coverage, but on the empathy task confidence carries no information (calibration error 0.538, accuracy in the confident subset 0.383 against a 0.371 base rate). Fourth, on the Indian English dialect task, where annotation models routinely perform worst, the decision model’s calibration error of 0.063 is less than half its median across the other utterance-family tasks (0.157) and the lowest of the 22 models evaluated on that task. Finally, cascades that keep confident items on the decision model and escalate the rest to an LLM, match the partner LLM alone at roughly a quarter to half of its measured cost. Together, our results suggest that decision models like Jev are not yet substitutes for frontier LLM annotation, but can already serve as an inexpensive first stage of an annotation pipeline, provided their stated confidence is validated on each construct before it is trusted.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,首先,商业决策模式在15项评估任务中的14项上跟踪了每个任务中最佳的LLM,中位值赤字为11.6宏-F1点,在对12项任务进行虚假发现修正后具有重大意义;对意识形态书籍、印度英语方言和字符串的信任间隔为零。 其次,其本土校准击败了19个LLM基线中16个而非3个前沿Claude模型(最佳基准的中间预期校准误差0.157比0.066)的口头信任. 第三,0.9置信度或高于0.876的物项在覆盖度上达到0.815的中位精度,但在共鸣任务上,置信度没有信息(校准误差0.538,置信度子集0.383的准确度与0.371的基准率). 第四,关于印度英语方言任务,即注解模式通常表现最差,决定模式0.063的校准误差还不到其他语系任务(0.157)的一半,是评价该任务的22种模式中最低的。 最后,连锁店使决策模型上的项目具有信心,并将其余部分升级为LLM,仅伙伴LLM就相当于其计量成本的四分之一至一半。 我们的结果表明,像Jev这样的决策模型尚不能取代前沿LLM注释,但已经可作为注释管道的低廉的第一阶段,只要它们所说的对每个构件的信心在被信任之前都得到验证。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Computational social science has long needed more labeled text than it can afford to annotate [ 8 ] , and the field’s response to each generation of language technology has been to test it as an annotator, from crowdsourcing [ 9 ] to GPT-3-era few-shot labeling [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Ziems et al. [1] gave this practice its systematic foundation, evaluating 13 language models on 25 CSS benchmarks and concluding that zero-shot LLMs fail to outperform fine-tuned baselines on classification but reach agreement levels adequate for use inside human annotation teams; their released pipeline, prompts, and test splits define the foundation for this study. Parallel work reported that ChatGPT exceeded crowdworker accuracy on several political text tasks [ 2 , 3 ] and that LLMs recover psychological constructs from text at scale [ 13 ] , with broader programs proposing LLMs as simulated respondents and research instruments [ 14 , 15 ] . A validity literature followed on when LLM labels can substitute for human ones, covering error propagation into downstream estimates [ 4 ] , field-level risks of uncritical adoption [ 16 ] , and procedures for deciding when a model may replace an annotator [ 17 ] . Automated labels of this kind already carry large-scale measurement studies, from partisan-content audits of TikTok [ 18 ] and stance detection on Twitter/X [ 19 ] to LLM-based rewriting of news text [ 20 ] . At the same time, direct evaluations report task-dependent performance of LLMs against humans [ 21 ] and measurable ideological slant and inconsistency in the models themselves [ 22 ] , which strengthens the case for validating model labels before they enter published estimates. This literature evaluates chat models through their generated text; decision models change the object of evaluation, because the model returns a distribution over the codebook rather than a string, and the validity question extends from accuracy to calibration.
blocks.zh: 计算社会科学长期需要更多的标注文字, 齐姆斯等人. [1] 给这种做法提供了系统的基础,评价了25个CSS基准的13种语言模型,并得出结论:零射线LLMs未能在分类上达到优于微调的基线,但达到了足以在人类注解团队内使用的协议水平;其释放的管道,提示和测试分解确定了本研究的基础. 并行工作报告称,ChatGPT在一些政治文本任务[2,3]上超过了众工的准确度,LLMS从文本中恢复了规模[13]的心理构造,更广泛的方案提出LLMs作为模拟应答者和研究仪器[14,15]. 关于LLM标签何时可以取代人类标签,包括将错误传播到下游估计值[4],实地一级无批判性采用的风险[16],以及决定模型何时可以取代注释员的程序[17]。 从TikTok [18] 的党派内容审计、推特/X [19] 的姿势检测到基于LLM的重写新闻文本[20], 同时,直接的评价报告了LLMS对人类的依赖任务性表现[21],以及模型本身可测量的意识形态倾向性和不一致性[22],这加强了在输入公布的估计之前验证模型标签的理由. 这种文献通过生成的文本来评价聊天模型;决定模型会改变评价对象,因为模型会返回代码本上的分布而不是字符串,有效性问题从准确到校准.

blocks.en: Decision models descend from the reinforcement-learning-from-feedback lineage that produced instruction-tuned assistants [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] , but they optimize a different objective: the model answers typed questions under a reward that penalizes miscalibrated probabilities, so the objective favors accurate probabilities over fluent text. TypeSafe’s Jev [ 26 ] is the first such model offered commercially; open-weight counterparts built on the Qwen model family [ 27 , 6 ] permit local inference and, in this study, an ablation that isolates the contribution of the training from that of constrained decoding. The training method, reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions, shares an acronym with reinforcement learning from contrastive distillation [ 7 ] , a preference-data generation method for alignment; the two are unrelated, and we use the full phrase where confusion is possible. Within days of Jev’s release, an ecosystem of open-weight reproductions appeared, spanning frozen-model logit readouts [ 28 ] , contrastively trained adapters [ 29 ] , purpose-trained small decoders [ 30 ] , and encoder-based implementations [ 31 ] , tracked by a community leaderboard [ 32 ] concurrent with this study; we evaluate five of these systems on our grid in Appendix B . We are not aware of any published evaluation of decision models on social science annotation.
blocks.zh: 决策模型来自产生指令调制助手的强化-学习-从反馈的血统[23,24,25],但它们优化了不同的目标:模型在惩罚误判概率的奖励下键入问题,因此客观偏好准确概率而不是流利文本. TypeSafe的Jev[26]是商业上提供的第一个这种模式;基于Quen模式家族的开放重量对应方[27,6]允许当地推论,在本研究中,一种将培训的贡献与受限制的解码隔离开来的做法。 训练方法 强化学习 校准决定 与强化学习 对比衍射 [7] 共享一个缩略语,是一种偏好数据生成方法 校正;两者无关,我们使用完全短语,在可能混淆的地方使用. 在Jev发布后几天内,出现了一个开放量繁殖的生态系统,它跨越了冷冻模型的登录[28],对比性训练有素的适配器[29],目的训练有素的小型解码器[30],以及基于编码器的执行[31],由社区领导板[32]与本研究同步跟踪;我们在附录B中评估了我们网格上的五个系统。 我们不知道有任何关于社会科学说明的决策模式的公开评价。

blocks.en: Routing items by model confidence is selective prediction, a problem with a fifty-year history beginning with the reject option in pattern recognition [ 33 ] and formalized for deep networks as selective classification [ 34 ] . Its usefulness depends entirely on calibration, conventionally measured by expected calibration error [ 35 ] , and modern neural networks are known to be miscalibrated by default [ 36 ] . For language models the evidence is mixed: larger models show partial knowledge of what they know when probabilities are read from logits [ 37 ] and can be taught to express uncertainty in words [ 38 ] , but many commercial serving APIs no longer expose token probabilities, and verbalized confidence elicited from chat models is systematically overconfident [ 5 , 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 以模型置信方式运行项目是选择性预测,这是五十年历史的一个问题,从模式识别中的拒绝选项开始[33],并将深层网络正式定为选择性分类[34]. 它的有用性完全取决于校准,通常通过预期校准误差来衡量[35],现代神经网络已知默认误差[36]. 对语言模型来说,证据是混杂的:较大的模型显示,当概率从对数中读取[37]时,它们所知道的情况是部分的,并且可以被教导用词[38]来表达不确定性,但许多为API服务的商业广告不再暴露出象征性概率,从聊天模型中引申出来的口头化信心是系统性的过度自信[5,39].

blocks.en: Routing each item to the cheapest system that can handle it is an established design for reducing annotation cost: model cascades escalate items by predicted difficulty or confidence [ 40 , 41 ] , and related work studies when to defer to a human expert [ 42 ] and how to set confidence thresholds in human–LLM verification pipelines [ 43 ] . Every design in this family takes a confidence signal as input, so its guarantees depend on that signal being calibrated. Decision models supply the signal natively, because the distribution the router needs is the model’s standard output, at a small fraction of frontier chat prices. Here, we test whether that distribution remains calibrated on CSS constructs.
blocks.zh: 将每件物品置于最廉价的系统处理,是降低注解成本的既定设计:模型级联通过预测难度或置信度使物品升级[40,41],以及相关的工作研究:何时服从一位人类专家[42],以及如何设定人-LLM核查管道中的信任阈值[43]。 这个家庭的每一个设计都以一个信心信号作为输入,所以它的保证取决于该信号的校准. 决策模型以本土方式提供信号,因为路由器需要的分布是模型的标准输出,只占前沿聊天价格的一小部分. 在这里,我们测试这种分布是否仍然在CSS构造上校准.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Mirror design
blocks.zh: 3.1 镜像设计

blocks.en: We reuse the evaluation suite of Ziems et al. [1] : 18 closed-choice classification tasks, the same released test splits (class-stratified samples of at most 500 instances per task; 7,977 items in total), the same gold labels, and their prompting guidelines. Their published zero-shot results for FLAN-T5, GPT-3-series, and GPT-4 models, and their fine-tuned RoBERTa-large baselines, serve as historical comparison columns; we do not rerun their models. The task grid spans ten utterance-level tasks (dialect features [ 44 ] , emotion [ 45 ] , figurative language [ 46 ] , implicit hate [ 47 ] , humor [ 48 ] , ideology [ 49 ] , misinformation [ 50 ] , persuasion [ 51 ] , stance [ 52 ] , and semantic change [ 53 ] ), six conversation-level tasks (discourse acts [ 54 ] , empathy [ 55 ] , persuasion strategies [ 56 ] , power [ 57 ] , toxicity prediction [ 58 ] , and politeness [ 59 ] , several drawn through ConvoKit [ 60 ] ), and two document-level tasks, media ideology [ 61 ] and character tropes [ 62 , 63 ] . Their five generation tasks are excluded by construction, because decision models do not generate free text, and two classification tasks whose released format is not closed-choice, hippocorpus (variable-length sentence-set extraction) and wikievents (free-text JSON slot filling), are excluded on the same ground. We treat this as a division of labor rather than a deficiency of the comparison: decision models are candidates for the labeling half of the CSS pipeline, and the explanatory half remains with generative models.
blocks.zh: 我们重用Ziems等人的评估套件。 [1]:18个闭合选择分类任务,同样的释放的测试分裂(每个任务最多500例的级级分样本;共7,977件),相同的金色标签,以及它们的提示准则. 他们公布的FLAN-T5,GPT-3系列和GPT-4型号的零镜头结果,及其微调的RoBERTa大基线,作为历史对比列;我们不重运行他们的模型. 任务网跨10个语音级任务(对调特征[44],情感[45],虚构语言[46],隐含仇恨[47],幽默[48],意识形态[49],错误信息[50],说服[51],姿态[52],以及语义变化[53]),6个对话级任务(散文行为[54],同情[55],说服策略[56],权力[57],毒性预测[58],礼貌[59],通过ConvoKit[60]绘制的几个任务),以及两个文件级任务,媒体意识形态[61]和字符串[62,63]. 他们的五个生成任务被构建排除在外,因为决策模型不会生成免费文本,而两个发布格式不是闭合选择的分类任务,河马(可变长的句子集提取)和维基事件(自由文本JSON插槽填充)在同一地段被排除在外. 我们将此视为分工而不是比较的缺陷:决定模型是CSS管道一半的标签的候选者,解释性的一半仍然是基因模型。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate three decision-class models: Jev 1.13 (TypeSafe, via the OpenRouter decisions endpoint; the resolved model version and serving provider are recorded with every call), an open-weight 0.6B RLCD-trained decision model built on Qwen3-0.6B-Base (local inference on university HPC), and a no-training ablation that applies the identical letter-token constrained-decoding pattern to the same vanilla base model, isolating the effect of RLCD training. Against these we run 19 LLM baselines via the OpenRouter, spanning the GPT-5.6, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, GLM, Kimi, and Gemma families; the full roster with resolved versions appears in the appendix reproducibility table. OpenAI and Gemini baselines run at reasoning effort “low”; Kimi K2.6 runs with reasoning disabled and GLM 5.3 at reasoning effort “low”, after both produced widespread empty completions from reasoning-token exhaustion in a first pass; all other LLM baselines run at temperature zero. LLM baselines receive Ziems et al.’s released prompts verbatim, plus one appended line eliciting a verbalized confidence from 0 to 100; a robustness check on the pilot tasks shows the appended line does not drive the accuracy comparisons, changing accuracy by a median of + 0.2 +0.2 points across the 48 pilot-task cells (median absolute change 1.7 points; Table 6 ). Decision models receive the same instruction text and the same option descriptions, restated in the decisions API format as a typed choice question whose criteria are keyed by the gold label names. The mapping from each task’s multiple-choice options to gold labels is fixed in code and was checked by hand against the gold label set. After registration, five open-weight decision systems released in the week of Jev’s launch (Laya, decider-0.8b, decider-2b, SemIf, and Bespoke-Nimble-9B, spanning 0.4B to 9B parameters and three architectural recipes) were run on the same grid under each system’s own released inference code; their construction and results are reported separately in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们评价三个决策类模型:Jev 1.13(TypeSafe,通过OpenRouter决定端点;已解析的模型版本和服务提供方每一次通话都会录制),基于Qune3-0.6B-Base(当地对大学HPC的推论)的开放重量0.6B RLCD训练式决定模型,以及将相同的字母键限制解码模式应用到同一梵地拉基模型的无训练解码模式,隔离了RLCD训练的效果. 相反,我们通过OpenRouter运行19个LLM基线,涵盖GPT-5.6、Claude、双子座、Llama、Quen、DeepSeek、Mistral、GLM、Kimi和Gemma等家庭;完整名册和已解决版本载于附录的可复制性表。 OpenAI和双子座基线在推理工作“低”时运行;Kimi K2.6在推理工作“低”时运行,而GLM 5.3在推理工作“低”时运行,这两条基线在第一次通过时都产生了大量从推理到计算耗尽的空完成;所有其他LLM基线在零温下运行。 LLM基线收到Ziems等人发出的逐字提示,加上一条附加线,引起0至100的口头信任;对试点任务的严格检查显示,所附线不会推动准确性比较,在48个试点任务单元格中,精确度改变中位数+0.2+0.2(中间绝对变化1.7点;表6)。 决策模型收到相同的指令文本和相同的选项描述,在决定API格式中作为打字选择问题重述,其标准由金标签名称键入. 从每个任务的多选择选项到金色标签的映射被固定在代码中,并对照金色标签集进行手工检查. 在登记后,在Jev发射一周内发布的5个开放量级决策系统(Laya,决定者-0.8b,决定者-2b,SemIf,和Bespoke-Nimble-9B, 跨度为0.4B至9B参数和3个建筑配方)根据每个系统自己发布的推论代码在同一网格上运行;其构建和结果分别载于附录B。

blocks.en: 3.3 Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 计量

blocks.en: We report four measurement outcomes per task and model. First, accuracy and macro-F1 against gold labels, the metric of Ziems et al. [1] , computed on identical test items. Second, calibration: expected calibration error with 15 equal-width bins, computed on the decision models’ returned confidence and on the probability of the chosen option, with reliability diagrams per task; LLM baselines, whose serving APIs return no usable token probabilities, are evaluated on verbalized confidence elicited in the same call and labeled as such. Third, coverage–accuracy routing curves: for each confidence threshold t ∈ { 0.5 , 0.6 , 0.7 , 0.8 , 0.9 , 0.95 } t\in\{0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95\} , the fraction of items at or above threshold (coverage) and the accuracy within that fraction. Fourth, measured cost in dollars per task and extrapolated per million labels; inference pricing varies across providers and over time, so every cost figure reports the price measured at the time of the study (September 2026), taken from the per-call billing records. Calibration throughout is measured against the single adjudicated gold label per item, so our results speak to calibration against benchmark gold standards rather than to the underlying constructs, on which trained annotators themselves disagree; the one grid task with released per-annotator scores is tested against them directly in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们报告每项任务和模式的四项衡量结果。 第一,精度和宏F1对金色标签,Ziems等人的度量衡. [1],根据相同的测试项目计算. 第二,校准:预计校准错误为15个等宽箱,根据决策模型返回的置信度和所选选项的概率计算,并附有每个任务的可靠性图; LLM 基线,其服务性API不返回任何可用符号概率,则根据同一调用和标注的口服置信度进行评估。 第三,覆盖-准确的路由曲线:对于每个置信阈值 t {{0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95} t\in 0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95},在阈值或高于阈值(覆盖)的物品的分数以及该分数内的准确度. 第四,按任务以美元计价,并推算出每百万个标签;推论定价因提供者而异,并随时间而异,因此每个成本数字都报告研究时(2026年9月)所测价格,取自每张计费记录. 校准全过程都以每个物品的单一裁定金牌来衡量,因此我们的结果是参照基准金牌标准来校准,而不是根据经过训练的注释者本身不同意的基本结构来衡量;在附录B中直接对照每个注释者得分的网格任务。

blocks.en: 3.4 Analysis plan and inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 分析计划和推论

blocks.en: Our pre-registration (AsPredicted #312,511) fixes the full grid (tasks × \times models × \times metrics), one characterization question, three hypotheses, and the confidence-cascade analysis, including the routing rule, both partner-selection rules (best frontier LLM and best LLM under $0.50 per 1,000 items), and the evaluated threshold grid. The characterization question asks on which tasks Jev beats the best LLM baseline, estimated as per-task Δ \Delta F1 with paired-bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals and related to five task features, without a directional prediction. The three hypotheses are that (1) Jev’s median expected calibration error is lower than the verbalized-confidence calibration error of every LLM baseline; (2) that on the median evaluation task, items with Jev confidence of at least 0.9 reach accuracy of at least 0.85 at coverage of at least 0.15; and (3) that Jev’s calibration error on the Indian English dialect task exceeds its median over the other utterance-family evaluation tasks. The three pilot tasks are stance, implicit hate, and discourse acts; the remaining 15 evaluation tasks carry every headline comparison. Model-to-model F1 differences are tested with a paired bootstrap over items (10,000 resamples, fixed seed) per task, with Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate control at q = 0.05 q=0.05 across the full task-by-comparison grid [ 64 ] . We note three departures from the pre-registration. First, the character-tropes cell is unrunnable for the two 0.6B decision models, whose architecture decodes over 26 letter tokens, and is reported as N/A. Second, the Kimi and GLM inference configurations were adjusted after reasoning-token exhaustion (Section 3.2). Lastly, per-call timestamps were not recorded, so throughput is not reported. Exploratory analyses appear in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.1 Accuracy against gold labels
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 对金色标签的精确度

blocks.en: We begin by examining annotation accuracy, the part of the evaluation that mirrors Ziems et al. [1] directly. Table 1 reports macro-F1 for the three decision-class models and the 19 LLM baselines on all 18 tasks, alongside the published 2023 values for the random baseline, the fine-tuned RoBERTa-large models, and GPT-4. We compare Jev against the per-task best LLM with paired-bootstrap confidence intervals, and we test all 342 task-by-comparison cells with BH-FDR correction at q = 0.05 q=0.05 ; 194 cells are significant after correction.

blocks.en: Across the 15 evaluation tasks, Jev reaches a median accuracy of 0.610 and a median macro-F1 of 0.581, a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points to the per-task best LLM, and the deficit is significant after correction on 12 of the 15 tasks. The per-task best is selected on the same test items, an oracle comparator that favors the LLM side of every comparison. On two further tasks Jev is statistically comparable to the best LLM: ideological books ( Δ \Delta F1 = − 2.1 =-2.1 points, CI [ − 5.9 , + 1.8 ] [-5.9,+1.8] ) and character tropes ( − 7.1 -7.1 points, CI [ − 14.4 , + 0.3 ] [-14.4,+0.3] ). On the remaining task, Indian English dialect, Jev posts the best point estimate in the grid ( + 4.2 +4.2 points over the best LLM), though the confidence interval spans zero here as well (CI [ − 3.9 , + 11.5 ] [-3.9,+11.5] ). A selection-aware bootstrap that re-selects the best LLM inside each resample (Appendix B ) leaves the ideological-books and dialect intervals spanning zero but moves the character-tropes interval below it ( [ − 15.5 , − 1.4 ] [-15.5,-1.4] points), so that exception is sensitive to the selection step. The historical columns place these numbers in context: the best 2026 zero-shot model exceeds Ziems et al.’s GPT-4 on every task except stance and character tropes, yet still trails their fine-tuned RoBERTa-large on 9 of the 17 tasks with a released fine-tuned value, so the 2023 conclusion that zero-shot models do not replace supervised classifiers survives three years of model progress.

blocks.en: 4.2 Calibration of stated confidence
blocks.zh: 4.2 校准所述信任

blocks.en: We next examine whether the confidence a model states can be believed, a measurement the 2023 evaluation could not include. For the decision-class models we compute expected calibration error directly from the returned distributions; for the LLM baselines we compute it from verbalized confidence. Table 2 and Figure 1 summarize the grid.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将审查是否能够相信模式状态,2023年评价不能包括这一衡量。 对于决策类模型,我们直接从返回的分布中计算出预期的校准错误;对于LLM基线,我们从口头信任中计算出来。 表2和图1概述了电网。

blocks.en: Our calibration hypothesis, that the decision model’s calibration error would be lower than that of every baseline, holds against 16 of the 19 baselines but fails against the three frontier Claude models, and is therefore unsupported as stated. Jev’s median expected calibration error over the evaluation tasks is 0.157 (95 percent task-level bootstrap CI [ 0.108 , 0.233 ] [0.108,0.233] ), lower than the verbalized-confidence error of 16 of the 19 LLM baselines but higher than that of the three frontier Claude models (Opus 5 at 0.066, CI [ 0.046 , 0.137 ] [0.046,0.137] ; Fable 5.1 at 0.073; Sonnet 5 at 0.075). The median intervals overlap, reflecting a median over 15 tasks of at most 500 items each; per-task intervals appear in Appendix B . These comparisons use 15 equal-width bins, and are conditional on the model returning a usable confidence: items whose verbalized confidence is absent or negative are kept for accuracy but excluded from calibration and routing (Table 4 ; DeepSeek V3.2 declines to estimate on 55 percent of items), whereas the decision models return a distribution on every call. Under equal-mass binning the frontier margin narrows and Sonnet 5 falls slightly behind Jev, while Opus 5 stays ahead under every binning (Appendix B ). The hypothesis required Jev to beat every baseline, and the models that beat it do so on verbalized confidence, a signal the calibration literature characterizes as systematically overconfident [ 5 , 39 ] ; on this suite it nonetheless shows a lower median calibration error than the decision model’s native distribution. Jev’s miscalibration is concentrated rather than uniform: the empathy task contributes a calibration error of 0.538, and removing it lowers the median only to 0.142, still above the three frontier Claude point estimates. The 0.6B RLCD model reports a lower median calibration error than Jev (0.128), but its median Brier score of 0.662 and coverage–accuracy area of 0.505 suggest a confidence signal with almost no ranking value.
blocks.zh: 我们的校准假说,即决定模型的校准误差将低于每个基准,这与19个基准中的16个相对,但与三个前沿的克劳德模型相悖,因此没有如上所述得到支持。 Jev对评价任务的预期校准误差中位数为0.157(95%的任务级靴子CI[0.108,0.233]][0.108,0.233]),低于19个LLM基线中的16个的口头化-自信误差,但高于三个前沿克劳德模型(Opus 5 at 0.066,CI [0.046,0.137] [0.046,0.137];Fable 5.1 at 0.073;Sonnet 5 at 0.075). 中间间隔重叠,反映15项以上任务的中位数,每个任务最多500项;每个任务间隔载于附录B。 这些比较使用15个等宽的箱,并以模型返回可用信心为条件:其口语化的置信度缺失或负值的项目保留在准确性上,但被排除在校准和路由之外(表4;DeepSeek V3.2下降至估计55%的项目),而决策模型则在每次通话时都返回分布。 在平等质量下将边疆边角缩小,Sonnet 5略落后于Jev,而Opus 5则在每一次宾场下保持领先(附录B ). 假说要求Jev击败每一个基线,而击败它的模型是在口头化的自信上击败的,校准文献将这个信号定性为系统性的过度自信[5,39];然而,在这个套房中,它显示的中位校准误差低于决策模型的本土分布. Jev的误差是集中的而不是统一的:共鸣任务造成了0.538的校准错误,去掉它只将中值降低到0.142,仍然高于三个前沿克劳德点的估计. 0.6B的RLCD模型报告了比Jev(0.128)更低的中位校准误差,但其中位Brier分数为0.662,覆盖-精确区为0.505,表明信任信号几乎没有排名值.

blocks.en: 4.3 Calibration on dialect text
blocks.zh: 4.3 方言文本校准

blocks.en: Detectors and annotation models routinely perform worst on non-Western and dialectal text, and our dialect-robustness hypothesis expected the same pattern here, namely, that Jev’s calibration error on the Indian English dialect task would exceed its median over the other utterance-family evaluation tasks. The concern was that a confidence signal trained on commercial decision workloads would be least trustworthy where its training data are sparsest.
blocks.zh: 探测器和注释模型通常在非西方和方言文本上表现最差,我们的方言-硬调假说预计这里也有同样的模式,即Jev对印度英语方言任务的校准误差将超过其他语系评价任务的中位数。 担心的是,在商业决策工作量方面受过培训的信任信号在培训数据最少的地方最不可信。

blocks.en: Our data reject the hypothesis in the opposite direction. Jev’s calibration error on the dialect task is 0.063, against a median of 0.157 over the other seven utterance-family tasks, and it is the lowest of all 22 models on that task; the next lowest is 0.181. The dialect task is also where Jev’s accuracy advantage is largest ( + 4.2 +4.2 F1 points over the best LLM, the only positive point estimate in the grid) and where its errors are most complementary to LLM errors: among the 266 items, Jev alone is correct on 106 while the best LLM alone is correct on 40. One test on one dialect cannot certify fairness, and we return to this limit in the Discussion, but the specific failure direction we anticipated did not occur.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据否定了相反方向的假设。 Jev在方言任务上的校准误差为0.063,相对于其他7个语音家庭任务的中位数0.157,它是该任务上所有22种模型中最低的;次低为0.181. 方言任务也是Jev的精度优势最大(+4.2+4.2 F1在最佳LLM之上得分,是网格中唯一的正点估计),其错误最能补充LLM错误的地方:在266项中,Jev单独正确在106项,而最佳LLM单独正确在40项. 对一种方言进行一项测试不能证明公平,我们在讨论中回到这一限度,但是我们预期的具体失败方向没有发生.

blocks.en: 4.4 Coverage and accuracy under confidence routing
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 保密路线下的覆盖面和准确性

blocks.en: We next ask whether the calibrated confidence scores of a decision model could be used to route low-confidence labels to a human or a stronger model. Our routing hypothesis required that, on the median evaluation task, items with Jev confidence at or above 0.9 reach an accuracy of at least 0.85 while covering at least 15 percent of items; the two thresholds set a minimal bar for routing to be worthwhile, requiring confident labels to be accurate enough to keep and frequent enough to reduce annotation cost. Figure 5 in the appendix shows the full per-task coverage–accuracy curves.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问,一个决定模型的校准置信分数是可以用来将低信心标签引向一个人类模型,还是更强大的模型. 我们的路由假设要求,在中位评价任务上,Jev置信度为0.9或高于0.9的项目的精度至少达到0.85,同时涵盖至少15%的项目;两个阈值为路由设置了一个最起码的条线,使路由值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 附录中的图5显示了每个任务的全覆盖率-准确度曲线。

blocks.en: At the 0.9 threshold, the median task covers 0.376 of items (95 percent CI [ 0.202 , 0.526 ] [0.202,0.526] ) at an accuracy of 0.815 (CI [ 0.691 , 0.897 ] [0.691,0.897] ). The coverage condition holds while the accuracy condition fails on the point estimate, and the hypothesis is therefore unsupported, though the accuracy interval includes the 0.85 target. Around this median, the task-level spread is wide. Six of the 14 evaluation tasks with a non-empty confident subset clear the 0.85 target (figurative language 0.975, Indian English dialect 0.922, semantic change 0.909), while conversation-level tasks fall well short (toxicity prediction 0.611, Wikipedia corpus power 0.644). The clearest failure is the empathy task, where 78 percent of items receive confidence of at least 0.9 and their accuracy is 0.383 against a full-task base rate of 0.371. Excluding empathy raises the median accuracy at the 0.9 threshold only to 0.824, so the hypothesis fails with or without it. Confident items alone are therefore not accurate enough to keep unconditionally, but the confidence signal retains ranking value on most tasks, and Section 4.5 below tests whether it is still worth routing on when the escalated items go to an LLM rather than a human.
blocks.zh: 在0.9阈值下,中间任务涵盖0.376项(95%CI [0.202,0.526]),精度为0.815(CI [0.691,0.897] [0.691,0.897]). 覆盖条件在准确性条件在点估计上失败时维持,因此该假说没有支持,虽然准确性间隔包括0.85目标. 围绕这个中位数,任务级别分布很广. 14项评价任务中,有6项带有非空自信子集,明确了0.85目标(figural language 0.975,印度英语方言0.922,语义变化0.909),而对话级别的任务则远远不够(毒性预测0.611,维基百科力0.644)。 最明显的失败是共鸣任务,其中78%的物品至少获得0.9的置信度,其准确度为0.383,而全任务基准率为0.371。 排除同情,将0.9阈值的中位精度只提高到0.824,因此假设无论有无,都失败了. 因此,仅凭自信物品不足以无条件保持准确性,但信心信号保留了大多数任务的排名值,下面第4.5节测试在升级物品进入LLM而不是人类时是否仍值得进行路由.

blocks.en: 4.5 Cost, efficiency, and cascades
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 成本、效率和级联

blocks.en: The decision-model class separates from every other model in the grid on cost (Figure 2 A). Labeling all 7,977 items across the 18 tasks cost $0.21 with Jev, against $0.34 to $62.99 for the 19 LLM baselines; per 1,000 items the measured prices are $0.027 for Jev, $0.04 to $0.50 for the hosted open-weight baselines, and $0.12 to $7.90 for the closed baselines (Table 3 ). On the median evaluation task Jev delivers 25.0 macro-F1 points per cent per 1,000 items, against 0.59 for the per-task best LLM (Figure 2 B), and the per-task best LLM costs a median 44 times more than Jev. Within Jev’s own price neighborhood the comparison narrows: among the six hosted open-weight baselines under $0.10 per 1,000 items, Jev’s median macro-F1 of 0.581 exceeds four and trails Gemma 4 31B (0.611) and Qwen3 235B (0.604). On the two tasks where the accuracy confidence interval spans zero under both the fixed and selection-aware comparisons, Jev matches the best LLM at 35 times (ideological books) and 44 times (dialect) lower measured cost; character tropes carries a still larger cost gap of 141 times, but its accuracy parity does not survive the selection-aware comparison (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 决策模型类在成本上与网格中所有其他模型相分离(图2 A). 将18项任务的7,977项标注在Jev上的费用为0.21美元,而19个LLM基线为0.34美元至62.99美元;每1 000项计量价格为Jev0.027美元,东道方开放重量基线为0.04美元至0.50美元,封闭基线为0.12美元至7.90美元(表3)。 关于中位评价任务,Jev每千项提供25.0个宏观-F1点,而每个任务最优LLM(图2 B)为0.59点,而每个任务最优LLM成本是Jev的44倍。 在Jev自己的价格附近,比较范围缩小:在每千项0.10美元以下的6个托管开放加权基线中,Jev的0.581个宏观-F1中位数超过4个,跟踪Gemma 4 31B(0.611)和Qune3 235B(0.604). 在固定和选择意识比较下,准确性置信间隔为零的两个任务上,Jev在35倍(意识形态书)和44倍(分辨)的测量成本下,匹配了最好的LLM;性格颤音带的成本差距仍然更大,为141倍,但其准确性均价并未能在选择意识比较(Appendix B.

blocks.en: We next ask whether the two model classes are worth combining. Specifically, we route each item by Jev’s confidence, keeping Jev’s label above the threshold and escalating the remainder to a partner LLM. We compare cascades to two partners across six confidence thresholds: the best frontier LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash (the highest median macro-F1, 0.669), and the best LLM under $0.50 per 1,000 items, Gemma 4 31B. Figure 3 shows the trade-off. The Gemini cascade holds the partner’s accuracy at a fraction of its price: at the 0.8 threshold the median task reaches 0.674 against 0.678 for Gemini alone, at 56 percent of its cost. The Gemma cascade exceeds the partner outright, reaching 0.638 against 0.626 at the 0.5 threshold, because the two systems err on different items. The third panel shows cascades to Haiku 4.5, the best closed model under the same price cap, and shows the same pattern: 0.639 against 0.622 for Haiku alone, at 27 percent of its cost.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问两个示范班是否值得合并。 具体地说,我们通过Jev的信心来引导每个物品,使Jev的标签高于门槛,并将其余的提升为合作伙伴LLM. 我们比较了两个合作伙伴的级联,它们跨越了六个信任阈值:最佳前沿LLM,双子座3.8 Flash(最高中位数宏F1,0.669),最佳LLM低于0.50‰,Gemma 4 31B。 图3显示权衡结果。 双子星级联将伴侣的准确性维持在价格的一小部分:在0.8阈值下,单双子星的中位任务就达到0.674,而单是0.678,其成本为56%。 Gemma级联完全超过合伙人,在0.5阈值下达到0.638对0.626,因为两种系统在不同的项目上出现错误. 第三个面板显示级联到海库4.5,这是同一价格上限下最好的封闭型号,并显示同样的模式:仅海库就0.639对0.622,成本的27%.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Decision models are marketed on three properties: labels at hundredths of a cent, a probability distribution over every label set, and a confidence score for every answer. Computational social science is a natural adopter, because annotation cost has long constrained the field’s designs [ 8 ] and its published estimates already rest on model-produced labels [ 2 , 3 ] . Our evaluation supports the first two properties: labeling the full 7,977-item grid cost $0.21, a median 44 times below the per-task best LLM, and the typed interface eliminated parsing failures, with zero invalid answers across the 23,703 registered decision-model calls. The third held on some constructs and failed on others, and all three of our hypotheses about the stated uncertainty, that its calibration error would be lower than every baseline’s, that high-confidence items would reach 0.85 accuracy at useful coverage, and that calibration would degrade on dialect text, were unsupported.
blocks.zh: 决策模型在三个属性上市:标签为百分点,在每个标签集的概率分布,以及每个答案的置信分数. 计算社会科学是一个自然的采纳者,因为注释成本长期以来制约了这个领域的设计[8],其公布的估计已经依赖于模型生产的标签[2,3]. 我们的评价支持前两个属性:标注完整的7,977项的网格成本为0.21美元,比每个任务最佳LLM低44倍中位数,打字界面消除解析失败,23,703个注册决定模型呼叫中零无效答案. 第三套关于某些构造的理论,而其他的理论则失败了,而我们关于所宣称的不确定性的所有三种假设,其校准误差将低于每个基线,高自信项目在有用的覆盖度下将达到0.85的精确度,校准在方言文本上会退化,这些都没有得到支持。

blocks.en: On accuracy, the decision model is not a substitute for a frontier LLM. It trails the per-task best baseline on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, by a median of 11.6 macro-F1 points, and none of the five task characteristics we examined (number of answer options, label balance, context length, task family, and difficulty for a fine-tuned baseline) predicted where the gap would close. The comparison to 2023 is instructive in both directions: today’s best zero-shot models clear the GPT-4 numbers of Ziems et al. [1] on nearly every task, yet fine-tuned RoBERTa-large still wins on half the suite, so the case for zero-shot annotation remains one about convenience and coverage rather than accuracy.
blocks.zh: 关于准确性,决定模式不能取代前沿LLM。 它以11.6个宏观-F1点的中位数追踪15项评价任务中的14项任务的最佳基线,我们审查的5项任务特点(答案选项的数目、标签平衡、上下文长度、任务家族、以及微调基线的困难)均未预测差距将在哪些地方缩小。 与2023年的比较在两个方向上都具有启发性:今天最优秀的零镜头模型清除了Ziems等人的GPT-4数字. [1] 几乎每一项任务,然而微调的RoBERTa大片仍然在半套房上获胜,因此零镜头注解的理由仍然是方便和覆盖,而不是准确性.

blocks.en: The decision model’s native distributions beat the verbalized confidence of 16 of 19 baselines, consistent with a literature that finds verbalized confidence systematically overconfident [ 5 , 39 ] , and three frontier models from a single vendor show a lower median calibration error than the decision model on that same signal. There are two potential explanations, and they are not exclusive. First, the RLCD training distribution is commercial decision workloads, and contested social science constructs are far from it, while frontier post-training appears increasingly to reward accurate self-assessment. Second, verbalized confidence draws on the full capability of a frontier model, so a stronger underlying classifier has less irreducible uncertainty to misstate. An artifact of our elicitation can be ruled out, because every LLM received the same single appended line and the robustness check shows its accuracy effect is negligible. Under either explanation, the 2023-era generalization that language models cannot state trustworthy confidence in words does not hold uniformly on this suite, and verbalized confidence is now a serious competitor to the class’s native distributions.
blocks.zh: 决策模式的本土分布打破了19个基线中16个基线的口语化信心,这符合一份发现口语化信心系统过度自信的文献[5,39],来自单一供应商的三个前沿模式显示的中位校准误差低于同一信号上的决定模式. 有两个潜在的解释,它们并非排他性的。 首先,区域发展发展中心的培训分配是商业决策工作量,有争议的社会科学结构远非如此,而前沿培训后似乎越来越多地奖励准确的自我评估。 第二,言语化的信心利用了前沿模型的全部能力,因此,更强大的基础分类器的不确定性更难于被错误描述. 由于每个LLM都收到相同的单条附加线,并且强度检查显示它的准确性效果是微不足道的,因此可以排除我们的诱导物。 无论哪种解释,2023年时代的语言模型不能表示对语言的可信信任的概括并没有统一地维持在这个套装上,而现在口头信任是该阶级本土分布的严肃竞争者.

blocks.en: The routing failure is concentrated rather than general. Six of 14 tasks cleared the 0.85 accuracy target in the confident subset, while on empathy classification the model assigned confidence of at least 0.9 to 78 percent of items and was wrong on 62 percent of them. Validating the confidence signal on one task therefore says little about the next, because the tasks where accuracy is lowest are not accompanied by low confidence scores. The dialect test makes the same point in the opposite direction, since we predicted calibration would degrade on Indian English dialect and instead found the model’s best-calibrated task. Both of our results support the same practice, a small gold-labeled validation set per construct before any confidence threshold is trusted.
blocks.zh: 线路故障是集中的,而不是一般的. 14项任务中有6项清除了自信子集中的0.85准确目标,而关于同情分类,模型赋予了至少0.9%至78%的项目信心,其中62%的项目是错误的。 因此,验证对一项任务的信任信号对下一个任务没有多大影响,因为准确度最低的任务没有伴之以较低的信任分数。 由于我们预测校准会降低印度英语方言, 我们两个结果都支持同样的做法,在信任任何信任阈值之前,每个构造都有一个金牌的小型验证装置。

blocks.en: For annotation pipelines, our results support a division of labor rather than a replacement. Used alone, the decision model is a reasonable choice where its accuracy is already competitive, and on those tasks the measured savings are 35 and 44 times (Appendix B ). Used as the first stage of a confidence cascade, it holds a frontier partner’s accuracy at roughly half the cost and exceeds a cheap partner outright, because the two classes err on different items. We note that API prices are intrinsic only for closed models, and for open-weight partners they are hosting prices that a well-utilized local deployment could undercut. For a team with its own hardware, open-weight LLMs label at cost; for one without, hosted open-weight inference already reaches Jev’s price neighborhood, and in that bracket the decision model’s case rests on its returned distribution and its complementary errors rather than on price alone.
blocks.zh: 对于注解管道,我们的结果支持分工而不是替代。 仅使用这一决策模式就是一种合理的选择,其准确性已经具有竞争力,在这些任务中,衡量的节余为35和44倍(附录B)。 作为信心级联的第一阶段,它把前沿伙伴的准确度控制在大约一半的成本上,并且完全超过廉价伙伴,因为这两个类别在不同项目上都是错误的。 我们注意到,消费物价指数价格只是封闭型号的固有价格,对于开放型伙伴来说,它们所承受的价格是利用良好的当地部署可能削弱的价格。 对于一个拥有自己硬件的团队来说,公开量级LLMs的标签是成本的;对于一个没有公开量级推论的团队来说,托管的公开量级推论已经达到了Jev的价位附近,在这个档次中,决定模型的情况取决于其返回的发行量和其补充性错误,而不仅仅是价格。

blocks.en:
Two properties of decision models nonetheless offer value regardless of where they rank on accuracy. The label space is enforced by construction, so the silent-parse-failure mode of chat-model annotation does not exist; constrained decoding can retrofit much of the same guarantee onto an LLM, though in our structured-output control (Appendix B ) it moved accuracy by less than a point and still let a handful of invalid answers through where the decisions endpoint allowed none. The returned object is a distribution over the codebook, so calibration is a measurable property of every labeling run rather than a separate elicitation. A model class need not lead on accuracy to be useful in the annotation pipeline if it is inexpensive and explicit about its uncertainty, and our cascade results quantify where and when that combination is useful.
This study is a 2026 snapshot of one commercial decision model, six open-weight counterparts between 0.4B and 9B parameters, and 18 English-language classification tasks, and it does not establish that decision models are calibrated on social science text in general, that the empathy failure is specific to that construct, or that frontier verbalized confidence will remain well calibrated as vendors change post-training recipes. All tasks are public benchmarks that predate the evaluated models, so training-data contamination cannot be excluded, and our results measure performance on established CSS benchmarks rather than generalization to genuinely unseen annotation problems. Three avenues follow directly. First, the headline evaluation covers a single vendor’s model at one point in time, and although the open ecosystem in Appendix B already spans three architectural recipes, every system in it was released within days of Jev; the mirror design is cheap to rerun as the class matures. Second, our dialect-robustness evidence is a single task, and a fuller audit across dialects, languages, and contested constructs is needed before any equity claim. Finally, post-hoc calibration deserves systematic study: in Appendix B , a scalar temperature fit on the three pilot tasks moves several inexpensive LLMs ahead of the decision model on evaluation-task calibration, so the class’s native-calibration advantage may not survive even minimal tuning of its competitors.
blocks.zh:
然而,决定模型的两种特性无论在准确性方面处于何种位置,都具有价值。 标签空间是通过构建来强制的,因此聊天-模型注释的无声-parse-失败模式并不存在;受限的解码可以将许多相同的担保修改到LLM上,尽管在我们的结构化-输出控制(Appendix B)中,它移动的精度小于一个点,仍然让少数无效的答案通过决定的结束点不允许没有. 返回的对象是代码簿上的分布,所以校准是每个标签运行的可测量属性,而不是单独的引出. 如果模型分类费用低廉,而且明确其不确定性,那么模型分类就不必导致准确性在说明过程中有用,而我们的级联结果则在何时何地加以量化。
这项研究是一份2026年商业决策模型的快照,6个开放量对应方在0.4B至9B参数之间,还有18个英语分类任务,它没有确定决策模型在一般社会科学文本上进行校准,同情失败是该构思特有的,或者随着供应商改变培训后食谱,边疆语言化的信心将保持良好的校准. 所有任务都是在评估模型之前的公共基准,因此不能排除培训数据污染,我们的成果是根据既定的CSS基准衡量业绩,而不是概括到真正看不见的说明问题。 三个途径直接遵循。 首先,头条评价涵盖了一个时间点的单一供应商模型,虽然附录B中的开放生态系统已经跨越了三个建筑食谱,但其中的每一个系统都在Jev的几天内发布;镜像设计在类成熟时可以便宜地重新运行. 其次,我们的方言-波动证据是一项单一的任务,在任何权益主张之前,都需要对方言、语言和有争议的构造进行更全面的审计。 最后,后校准值得系统研究:在附录B中,适合三个试点任务的标定温度将若干廉价的LLMs移动到评价-任务校准决策模型之前,因此,该阶层的本土校准优势甚至可能无法经受住竞争对手的微小调整。

blocks.en: Ziems et al. asked whether language models can annotate social science text and answered with a qualified yes. The successor question is no longer the price of the labels, which is settled; it is whether the model’s own account of their quality can be trusted. On present evidence it can be on some constructs and cannot be on others, and the two cases cannot be told apart without a per-construct check.
blocks.zh: 齐姆斯等人. 问语言模型是否能够对社会科学文本进行注释,并以限定的 " 是 " 回答。 后继问题已不再是标签的价格,它已经解决了;而是该模型自己对其质量的描述是否可以信任。 现有证据可以放在一些构件上,而不能放在其他构件上,没有按建筑情况进行核对,就无法将这两个案件分开审理。

blocks.en: 6 Ethics and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 道德和限制

blocks.en: All datasets are the public releases of Ziems et al. [1] and their upstream sources; no new human data was collected, and all reported quantities are aggregates over public benchmark items. Hate speech and toxicity items are quoted only as required for error analysis. Decision-model confidence scores evaluated here are contestable measurements, and our dialect-robustness cell tests one specific failure direction (non-Western dialect text); it does not certify fairness elsewhere, and the substantive limitations and the avenues they open are discussed at the end of the Discussion. Total inference spend for the full grid was $244.54, and the complete per-call records and analysis scripts are released for replication at https://github.com/hazemibrahim97/decision-models-css .

blocks.en: For each model we fit a scalar temperature on the logit of stated confidence by maximum likelihood on the pooled pilot-task items, then recompute evaluation-task ECE with the scaled confidence (Table 10 ). Scaling helps most where miscalibration is largest: Llama 4 Scout improves from 0.312 to 0.060 and Gemini 3.1 Pro from 0.233 to 0.076, both moving ahead of Jev, whose own scaled ECE is 0.121 (from 0.157, T = 2.66 T=2.66 ). Already-calibrated models gain nothing (Fable 5.1 unchanged) or lose slightly in the transfer across task sets (Opus 5, 0.066 to 0.086). A small labeled calibration set therefore yields frontier-level calibration for several inexpensive LLMs, which weakens the case that native calibration is the class’s advantage.

blocks.en: Among the evaluation tasks, only empathy shows a gap of at least 10 points between Jev’s accuracy and macro-F1, the signature of class-imbalanced predictions. Table 20 decomposes it: both Jev and Gemini 3.8 Flash collapse onto the no-exploration class, so the empathy failure is shared across model classes rather than specific to the decision model.

Table 21 recomputes every interval with the best LLM re-selected inside each of the 10,000 paired resamples, so the interval carries the uncertainty of the selection step. One verdict changes: the character-tropes interval moves from spanning zero to [ − 15.5 , − 1.4 ] [-15.5,-1.4] points; the ideological-books ( [ − 6.5 , + 0.1 ] [-6.5,+0.1] ) and dialect ( [ − 4.3 , + 9.8 ] [-4.3,+9.8] ) intervals continue to span zero, and every already-significant deficit remains so.

blocks.en: Politeness is the one grid task whose upstream release ships raw per-annotator scores (five annotators per item, 1–25 scale); all 498 test items match by request text. No model’s stated confidence tracks human disagreement: the Spearman correlation between per-item confidence and the five-score standard deviation is at most | ρ | = 0.14 |\rho|=0.14 across the six models tested, and the only significant coefficients are positive (Table 23 ). Accuracy is equally unrelated to disagreement (Jev ρ = − 0.01 \rho=-0.01 , Opus 5 ρ = − 0.03 \rho=-0.03 ). On this task, annotator disagreement is an axis of item difficulty that neither the decision model’s distribution nor verbalized confidence represents, the direct form of the gold-standard scoping in Section 3.3.

blocks.en: The zero-invalid-answer property of the decision models could reflect the output interface rather than the model class. As a control, Gemini 3.8 Flash is rerun on all 18 tasks with its answer forced through a JSON schema whose answer field enumerates the task’s options, with the same prompts and configuration otherwise, paired on identical items. Table 24 compares the two interfaces. Constrained output changes little: median evaluation-task macro-F1 moves from 0.669 to 0.676, with per-task changes from − 2.0 -2.0 to + 11.4 +11.4 points, the largest on the 114-option tropes task ( n = 113 n=113 ), so the free-text protocol of the registered runs does not meaningfully understate the LLM side. The interface guarantee itself transfers only partly: schema-constrained serving still returned 16 invalid answers on the paired item set (against 34 under free text and zero across all registered decision-model calls), because some provider responses fall back to unconstrained text.

blocks.en: Five open-weight decision systems released in the week of Jev’s launch, and tracked by a concurrent community leaderboard [ 32 ] , are run on the 17-task local grid under each system’s own released inference code: Laya, a 0.4B ModernBERT-large encoder answering in one forward pass [ 31 ] ; decider-0.8b and decider-2b, decoders trained for typed decisions on Qwen3.5 bases [ 30 ] ; SemIf, a frozen Qwen3.5-4B with a logit readout over option letters and no training [ 28 ] ; and Bespoke-Nimble-9B, a LoRA adapter on Qwen3.5-9B trained on roughly 3,000 contrastive examples [ 29 ] . The two systems that refuse over-length prompts rather than truncate receive states tail-truncated to fit, SemIf at the same 1,536-token budget as the registered local models; SemIf’s 16 answer slots also exclude the 23-option dialect task. These runs were added after registration and enter no registered comparison. Table 25 reports per-task macro-F1 with median macro-F1, ECE, and Brier over the evaluation tasks each system covers. Three regularities emerge. First, the commercial model keeps its lead, and its largest margin is the dialect task (64.0 against 46.0 for the best open system), but the gap closes with base-model scale rather than with decision training: the untrained 4B readout posts a higher median macro-F1 (55.0) than any trained open system, echoing at larger scale the registered result that the 0.6B RLCD model beats its untrained base (36.1 against 27.8). Second, calibration tracks the training objective rather than the size: decider-0.8b, trained under a proper scoring rule, reaches a median evaluation-task ECE of 0.081 against 0.163 for Jev on the same 14 tasks, the best-calibrated decision system in the study, at a median macro-F1 about 12 points below Jev’s, while Laya, SemIf, and Nimble post the worst calibration in the class (median ECE 0.217 to 0.275). Third, the empathy failure of Section 4 is a property of the construct, not the vendor: every decision system from the 0.4B encoder to the 9B adapter lands between 19.8 and 35.7 macro-F1 on empathy, and the two largest state mean confidence above 0.94 on that task. All five systems annotated their grids without an API account, four of them on a laptop.
blocks.zh: 在Jev推出的一周内发布的5个开放量级决策系统, 并由一个社区领导板跟踪, Laya,一个0.4B的现代BERT大编码器在一次前传回答[31];决定者-0.8b和决定者-2b,在Quen3.5基地接受打字决定培训的解码器[30];SemIf,一个冷冻的Quen3.5-4B,在选项函上读出记录,没有培训[28];和Bespec-Nimble-9B,一个在Quen3.5-9B上的LORA适配器,培训大约3000个对比实例[29]。 SemIf与注册的本地模式相同, 预算为1 536个; SemIf的16个答题段也排除了23个选项的方言任务。 这些记录是在登记后添加的,没有登记比较。 表25是每个系统涵盖的每个任务宏观-F1中值、欧洲经委会和布赖尔的评价报告。 三常出现. 首先,商业模式保持领先地位,其最大边际是方言任务(最佳开放系统为64.0对46.0),但差距与基模尺度而不是决策训练相近:未经过训练的4B读出器贴出的宏-F1(55.0)中位数高于任何经过训练的开放系统,更大规模地回响了注册结果,即0.6B的RLCD模型击败了未经训练的基底(36.1对27.8). 第二,校准跟踪培训目标,而不是规模:根据适当的评分规则培训的决策者-0.8b,就同样14项任务而言,对Jev的评价-任务中位数为0.081,对0.163,这是研究中最佳的校准决定系统,其宏观-F1中位数比Jev低12分,而Laya、SemIf和Nimble则在班级中排名最差的校准(中位数ECE 0.217至0.275)。 第三,第4节的同情失败是建筑的财产,而不是销售商:从0.4B编码器到9B适配器的每一个决定系统都在19.8至35.7宏观-F1之间进行同情,两个最大的州意味着对这项任务的信心超过0.94。 所有5个系统都没有API账户注解它们的网格,其中4个在笔记本电脑上.

blocks.en: Removing the empathy task, the grid’s largest calibration failure, lowers Jev’s median expected calibration error from 0.157 to 0.142 and raises median accuracy in the 0.9-confidence subset from 0.815 to 0.824; the calibration and routing conclusions are unchanged. On the three evaluation tasks where the accuracy difference to the per-task best LLM spans zero, Jev’s measured cost advantage is 35 × \times (ideological books, $0.016 against $0.568 per 1,000 items), 44 × \times (Indian English dialect, $0.048 against $2.135), and 141 × \times (character tropes, $0.222 against $31.40). The full-grid results remain the headline; ideological books and dialect are where the cost advantage comes with no accuracy deficit, while the character-tropes interval falls below zero once the best LLM is re-selected inside each resample (Table 21 ).
